"Free Carrier" means that the seller delivers the goods to the ( ) or another person nominated by the ( ) at the seller's premises or another named place. The ( ) are well advised to specify as clearly as possible the point within the named place of delivery, as the risk passes to the buyer at that point.

FCA requires the seller to clear the goods for export, where applicable. However, the ( ) has no obligation to clear the goods for import, pay any import duty or carry out any import customs formalities.
